jobs.title: Product UX Researcher (Mensch)

Deine Stärke ist die Neugier auf unsere Nutzer:innen: Du willst verstehen, wie sie arbeiten und was sie wirklich brauchen, und machst daraus gezielt Chancen für unser Produkt.

Nutzer:innen verstehen & Chancen entdecken:  Du tauchst tief in die Prozesse, Jobs-to-be-done und Tools unserer Kund:innen und Partner ein, sprichst mindestens einmal pro Woche direkt mit ihnen und machst aus Deinen Erkenntnissen Produktideen, die zu unserer Strategie passen

Eigene Themen von der Idee bis zum Go-live:  Du suchst Dir Deine Themen selbst, begleitest sie als Stakeholder end to end und entwickelst den Pitch gemeinsam mit dem Engineering-Team

Wirkung prüfen & dazulernen:  Du validierst nach dem Go-live Hypothesen zu Deinen eigenen Initiativen und zu denen anderer, schaust kritisch auf die Ergebnisse und holst Learnings aus dem Live-Betrieb zurück ins Team

Wissen teilen & Menschen verbinden:  Du gestaltest unsere Community of Practice, sorgst dafür, dass Informationen zwischen internen Stakeholdern und Team fließen, und bringst Produktänderungen gemeinsam mit dem Marketing gut nach innen und außen

Du machst unser Produkt als Ganzes besser:  Du hinterfragst Ideen konstruktiv, schaust über das Offensichtliche hinaus und gibst Impulse, auch bei Themen, zu denen Dich das Team dazuholt, weil Deine Expertise hilft

Was uns gefällt

Du bist neugierig auf Menschen und ihre Arbeit:  Du willst wirklich verstehen, wie unsere Kund:innen und Partner arbeiten, und hast Lust, dafür auch mal in anderen Abteilungen mitzuarbeiten

Du hinterfragst gern, auch Deine eigenen Ideen:  Du schaust ehrlich auf Ergebnisse und bleibst offen, wenn eine Hypothese nicht aufgeht. Für Dich ist das ein Learning und kein Rückschlag

Du bringst erste Erfahrung in der digitalen Productentwicklung mit:  Du hast Kundeninterviews oder User Research schon selbst gemacht und weißt, wie aus Erkenntnissen gute Produktideen werden

Teamplay auf Augenhöhe liegt Dir:  Du arbeitest gern eng mit Entwickler:innen zusammen, packst auch außerhalb Deiner Kernrolle mit an und bringst Dich da ein, wo Du am meisten bewirkst

Du kommunizierst klar und verständlich:  Ob Interview, Pitch oder Update für das Marketing: Du findest für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen den richtigen Ton

Zahlen und Technik machen Dich neugierig:  Tiefe Analytics- oder Tech-Skills brauchst Du nicht. Ein gutes Gespür für Daten ist ein Plus, den Rest lernst Du bei uns

Du bist ein AI Native:  Du nutzt AI-Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude ganz selbstverständlich um deine eigene Arbeit oder die deines Teams effizienter zu machen. Du hast kein Problem damit mit AI Prototypen zu erstellen um selbst zu testen ob deine Ideen funktionieren.

jobs.title: Lead UAS Systems & Edge AI Architect
jobs.description:
About Promethion Industries

Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. Our mission is to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces - through tightly integrated autonomy stacks designed and built in Europe. Our focus is defensive and counter-system capabilities, including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions.

We are looking for a Lead UAS Systems & Edge AI Architect.  Your mission with us

Own the end-to-end technical architecture of our autonomous aerial systems.

Define how flight control, edge compute, sensors, perception, state estimation, autonomy, RF/C2 and payload systems work together as one aircraft.

Define and maintain clear subsystem interfaces, timing budgets, compute budgets and integration.

Turn research prototypes into deployable airborne systems with clear interfaces, timing requirements and compute allocation.

Architect the onboard compute stack across flight controllers, embedded Linux systems, GPUs and dedicated accelerators.

Make pragmatic decisions between ROS2, existing middleware and custom high-performance runtime components.

Lead rapid integration of new cameras, sensing modalities, AI models and autonomy algorithms onto flying platforms.

Work directly with the aircraft, flight-test team and engineering leads to identify system bottlenecks and resolve them quickly.

Drive the system from laboratory prototypes toward robust, repeatable field operation.

Maintain a strong understanding of weight, power, thermal, latency, bandwidth and reliability constraints.

Own technical quality across subsystem boundaries and prevent local engineering decisions from compromising overall system performance.

Your contribution to the team  (required)

Significant hands-on experience architecting and deploying complex robotic or autonomous systems.

Strong experience with real hardware — not simulation-only development.

Experience deploying perception, autonomy or AI workloads onto embedded / edge compute.

Strong understanding of robotics software architecture, sensor pipelines and real-time systems.

Solid C++ and Linux background.

Experience with ROS / ROS2 or comparable robotics middleware.

Strong understanding of embedded compute, networking and hardware interfaces.

Ability to reason across perception, estimation, planning, flight control and embedded systems.

Proven ability to move quickly from system concept to working prototype.

Comfortable working directly with flight hardware, logs, telemetry and test equipment.

Proven experience taking at least one complex robotic or autonomous system from prototype to deployed operation.

Even if you don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply - we’d love to hear from you.  Find more  English Speaking Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow

jobs.description:
About the BIIE  The Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering (BIIE) is an independent Swiss research institute advancing immune engineering to improve the health of children and adolescents, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The Institute brings together expertise across immunology, bioengineering, computational biology and artificial intelligence, combining fundamental research with a focus on translating scientific discoveries into practical and accessible health solutions. Established through the initiative of Fondation Botnar, the BIIE is a young and growing international research institute based in the Basel region.  Position Overview  We are seeking a creative, proactive and versatile Communications Officer to help bring the research, people and mission of the BIIE to a wide range of audiences.  Reporting to the Head of Communications & Institute Relations, and working closely with scientific and administrative colleagues across the institute, you will help translate complex scientific topics and lead the planning and execution of a broad range of communications activities.  This is a hands-on role, covering digital communications, content creation, internal communications, events and the production of institutional materials. You will take responsibility for content management on the BIIE's website and the Institute’s LinkedIn channel, and the organisation of internal and external events.  Key Responsibilities  Content Creation

Develop, write, edit and design engaging content for different audiences and channels, including news articles, press releases, newsletters, presentations, flyers and institutional materials.  Work with scientists and colleagues across the Institute as well as partner organisations to identify compelling stories and translate complex scientific topics into clear, accessible content.  Coordinate the production of visual and multimedia content, including photography, video and graphics.

Website & Social Media

Further develop and manage the day-to-day content of the BIIE website, ensuring it remains accurate, engaging and up to date.  Plan and coordinate digital content through an editorial calendar, proactively identifying opportunities for storytelling.  Monitor digital performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Internal Communications

Develop and maintain effective internal communications channels to keep employees informed, connected and engaged.  Create and coordinate internal news, announcements and other communications materials.  Support all-staff meetings and other internal activities that strengthen the BIIE community and foster a shared institutional identity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Events

Support media relations activities, including media enquiries, press materials, media lists and monitoring.  Support stakeholder engagement activities, coordinating visits and meetings, and maintaining institutional contacts in a dedicated CRM.  Plan and coordinate internal and external BI

jobs.title: Environment Artist
jobs.description:
About Techtive Games  Techtive Games is a Germany-based video game developer creating  Ardem , an open-world survival game. Built by former modding veterans, the studio combines AA-level ambition with an independent mindset to push development practices forward and build immersive worlds built to be played, modified, and expanded.  We're looking for an Environment Artist to join our team as we move into full production on our debut game Ardem, an open world survival game developed in Unreal Engine 5.  In this role, your focus is asset production, with a strong emphasis on architecture and modularity. Our world artists build Ardem's world —> you create what they build it with: modular architecture kits, bespoke landmark structures, and the environmental assets that make the world feel believable and lived-in. You won't be doing level design yourself, but you need the instincts of someone who could — assets only work if they're made with world-building in mind. At Techtive, we believe in a creative workflow where everyone contributes to the final look and feel of the world. It's a team effort: you'll work closely with World Art, Tech Art, and 3D Art, using cutting-edge UE5 tech to push visuals to new heights.  One thing we care about a lot: we're hiring from our community. We want people who actually play survival games — not as market research, but because it's your genre. If you know from hundreds of hours in the genre why a base location feels right, why a ruin tells a story, or why clutter placement can make or break immersion, you already understand half the job.  That's also why we'd love it if you share your Steam profile with your application  — not as a gate, we're just genuinely curious where your gaming interests lie and how much they overlap with what we're building.  We value creativity, ownership, and personal growth. Rather than working through rigid ticket pipelines, our team members are encouraged to actively shape systems, improve workflows, and grow together not only on Ardem, but on future projects as well.  If you love building worlds players want to get lost in — and you've survived a few of them yourself — we'd love to hear from you.

Tasks

On a day to day basis, you will:

Create high-poly and low-poly models for environmental objects — with a clear focus on architecture: modular building kits, structures, and props

Overhaul and optimize our existing asset kits: consolidate materials, reduce poly counts, and bring everything to a consistent, performant standard

Create assets for bespoke landmark locations — the kind of places players remember

Design with modularity and reusability in mind, so our world artists can build more with less

Rework existing vegetation and natural assets to a cleaner, more maintainable standard where needed

Work from photo reference and concept art to hit a believable, grounded look

Produce clean, efficient UVs and game-ready assets that respect the technical limitations of a large open world

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.  Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.  Was wir bieten

Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle  Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo: ein kleiner, bildschirmfreier KI-Freund, der Kindern zwischen 4 und 9 ihre Warum-Fragen beantwortet. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Onoo in die Köpfe und Wohnzimmer von Eltern bringt.  Du bist unsere erste Marketing-Person, mit Platz am Gründertisch. Keine Agentur, kein Team unter dir, keine fertigen Prozesse. Du baust Marke, Community und Funnel von null auf – erst mit den eigenen Händen, dann mit einem Team. Du machst aus Onoo eine Marke, die Eltern sofort verstehen: Positionierung, Story, Ton – vom Video bis zum Karton.

Du schaltest Paid Social (Meta, TikTok) selbst

jobs.title: Blockchain Intelligence Analyst, Transnational Crime Organizations
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs  provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the role

We're looking for a Blockchain Intelligence Analyst to operate as a high-judgment, high-autonomy individual contributor specializing in transnational criminal organisations. You will use blockchain analytics, open-source and closed-source intelligence, and cryptocurrency attribution to trace the proceeds of drug trafficking, identify the networks that move them, and produce intelligence that helps TRM and its partners disrupt illicit drug activity.

This is not a people-management role. We're looking for an experienced analyst who can independently lead complex investigations, develop high-confidence assessments, uncover novel attribution, and raise the team's tradecraft through technical expertise and example. This role will require proactive work with law enforcement partners, often picking up a stalled investigation, finding what was missed, and linking it to other cases.

You should be equally comfortable tracing funds across blockchains, identifying laundering and cash-out infrastructure, correlating on-chain and off-chain signals, and turning fragmented data into clear, defensible intelligence that enables partners to make informed operational decisions.

The impact you will have

Produce finished intelligence on transnational criminal organisations, vendors, facilitators and laundering pathways, including actor profiles, lead packages and attribution assessments suitable for investigative, executive and partner audiences.

Lead complex end-to-end blockchain investigations from initial seed indicators, such as addresses, transactions, exchange exposure and infrastructure leads, through to full attribution.

Trace illicit proceeds across multiple blockchains, bridges, mixers, peel chains and nested services, identifying controllers, counterparties and cash-out points, including OTC desks, ATM networks and cash-to-crypto services.

Correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, closed-source intelligence and off-chain identity or infrastructure signals to build a complete picture of how transnational criminal organisations operate and move value.

Own investigative work-streams from discovery through validation and written production, drafting intelligence that is source-cited, auditable and operationally useful.

Build and maintain strong working relationships with law enforcement partners, so that our intelligence reflects real investigative tradecraft and gets used.

Help strengthen TRM's transnational criminal organisations coverage by contributing new attributions, refining investigative methodology and improving repeatable workflows.

Company Description

Workleap  is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines:  Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and  ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

At Workleap, our engineering teams already ships more than twice as fast with AI. Now we’re expanding beyond code to everything around it: briefs, specs, design, launch, and measurement. The idea is simple: agents do the work, and people make the calls. We’ve are rethinking how we build products and are exploring the technical possibilities, this is just the beginning. As a Senior AI Developer, you’ll join us to shape and build this solution ensuring that we have solid technical foundation.

Your impact:

Ship  the first production agents with our Product Managers, starting with brief creation and the ProductManager-to-design handoff, then extend to the rest of the product lifecycle.

Shape  the shared architecture and standards (orchestration, skills, memory, evals, guardrails) so that both our product lines are built on the same foundation.

Own  the production quality of these agents: observability, testing, security, and cost built in from the start, with human approval at every gate.

Co-design  with Product Managers: understand how they work, reuse what they’ve already automated, and ship small iterations they test and adopt.

Measure  what works: time saved, time from customer signal to shipped decision, and cost per agent and per feature, then cut what doesn’t add value.

Grow  others: share your agent development practices so the team can build, run, and improve agents on their own.

Your team

Over the next 6 to 12 months, you’ll work on questions like: how does an agent turn an idea into a brief that a Product Manager approves without rewriting it? How do specialized agents pass context without losing it or blowing up costs? How do we decide an agent is reliable enough to lighten a gate? The vision is set, and a proof of concept in Slack is underway: you’re joining early enough to shape the architecture and turn this start into a production standard.

You’ll join the  Product Ops team , a small team serving Product Manager across two product lines that already owns tracking, product data quality, and analytics. You’ll work daily with this team, our AI-Software Development Life Cycle team, which already automates software delivery, and with our Product Managers working on both product lines. You’ll also partner with the Senior AI Developer on our Data team to share patterns and tooling. We use AI every day, decide fast

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

You'll join Vinted's Trust & Safety domain, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. Across several detection, moderation and sanctioning teams, we run a growing set of machine learning models, rule engines, and LLM agents. They score every new listing, account and message at Vinted's scale, and many of them act on members automatically.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to shape the architecture and effectiveness of our detection systems as a whole. You'll tackle problems that individual teams cannot solve independently: how to maximize detection coverage, combine different models into coherent risk decisions, and allocate computational resources where they reduce the most harm.

This is a senior individual contributor role with scope across Trust & Safety and Security domains. You'll set technical direction, challenge existing approaches, prototype solutions and work with teams to bring them into production.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer, Pre-Training
jobs.description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer (Pre-training) to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state.

As a pre-training research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda.

We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions.

Qualifications

  • Strong engineering skills, especially any of: CUDA/Triton/Pallas/CuTe DSL kernel development, lower-level PyTorch/JAX/XLA development, CUDA Graphs, FPGA/ASIC experience
  • Must have two or more years work experience building deep learning systems, for any domain: robotics, biology, chemistry, physics, audio, video, recommendations, etc.
  • Experience translating methods between areas of application is highly valued
  • LLM experience is valuable, but not necessary
  • Finance experience is not required

The estimated base salary range for this position is 250,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos  [CEO]

Michael Monin  [Co-founder & CTO]

Thomas Lacroix  [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano  [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a  Security Engineer , you’ll own application security for a fast-growing AI companionship platform. This is a hands-on AppSec role: you’ll review code, find real vulnerabilities and drive fixes across the stack. You’ll be the main security person in the company, reporting directly to our CTO and Co-Founder. You’ll set direction yourself and explain risk clearly to non-security colleagues. Our product includes AI-generated content, including NSFW content, and you’ll also keep an eye on AI-specific threats like prompt injection. Real ownership from day one.

This isn’t an infrastructure, networking or DevSecOps role: we’re looking for application security depth.

Application security (the core of the role)

Review code every week to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

Find, prioritize and drive fixes for real vulnerabilities across the stack, not surface-level issues

Audits and pentests

Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests

Challenge findings where needed, and follow them through to fixes

Engineering and automation

Automate security work and build the tools you need to scale it

Use AI tools daily in your security work: code review, pentests and scripting

Ownership and communication

Own security end to end with little support, and decide what matters most

Explain

As a Navigation Engineer within our Precise Navigation team, you will design and develop high-precision navigation and positioning solutions based on tightly-coupled IMU/GNSS filtering, improving localisation accuracy, integrity, and robustness to jamming and spoofing for our autonomous systems – from concept to field deployment. Resilient PNT:  Develop navigation resilient to GNSS degradation, jamming and spoofing (anti-jam / anti-spoof).

Testing & Validation:  Design test plans (e.g. GNSS receiver testing in jamming environments), run simulations and replays, and report on findings and performance against targets.

Candidate Requirements

Experience with GNSS, INS/IMU and navigation/estimation filters (e.g. Kalman filtering), particularly in tightly-coupled architectures.

Experience with navigation in GNSS-denied / contested environments.

Solid software / algorithm skills; combined algo + software profile rather than a pure coder.

Broad engineering culture with understanding of electrical, embedded and mechanical systems.

Rigorous, structured and mission-driven mindset with strong analytical skills.

Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.

We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.  Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.  Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team:  Why Partly exists  and  AI at Partly .  🖍️ This role  This is a product-builder role, not a ticket-taking one. You own a product surface end to end: you talk to the customer, form the idea, build it, ship it, measure it, and decide what happens next. The same person who understands the repairer writes the code. There is no handoff for product quality to leak through.  You'll build at the center of a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still runs on phone calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Replacement parts is one of the largest physical markets on earth and one of the least digitised, and there is no established playbook to copy. Partly is creating the category.  Our moat is Interpreter, a domain-specific AI model that understands parts, vehicles, and the messy real-world relationships between them in ways general-purpose models cannot. It is what lets software finally make sense of a physical, offline industry, and it is the engine underneath everything you build.  And what you build is changing shape. We are not bolting AI onto old screens. We are creating genuinely new agentic experiences for a broad spectrum of users, from estimators and parts managers to accountants and suppliers, where people express intent and supervise outcomes while agents handle the mechanical work. You are responsible for translating regenerative agricultural expertise and science in arable farming systems in temperate climates into actionable, scalable digital products for farmers on Klim's platform. Contribute to roadmap and prioritization decisions based on farmer value, willingness to pay, partner value, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance.

Support farmer validation through interviews, feedback analysis, test cases, and field-reality checks.

Support expansion into new regions by working out how farming systems differ and what that means for our recommendations.

You have 5+ years of experience in farm management, agronomic advisory, farm business consultancy, or a comparable role where you carried responsibility for real decisions on real farms.

jobs.title: Policy Manager
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products.  Plaid  powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

As Plaid’s Public Policy Manager for the UK and EU, you’ll lead our policy work across both regions, partnering closely with our Head of Policy and Head of Europe Legal and Compliance. You’ll advocate for a secure, consumer-friendly financial ecosystem where people can use their financial data to access the products and services they need. The work spans some of the most important and fast-moving issues in financial services, from cybersecurity and privacy to data use and competition.

We’re looking for a resourceful, strategic thinker who reads political and regulatory dynamics well and finds a way forward. You’ll translate technical and business concepts into clear, actionable policy positions that help grow Plaid’s business and benefit our customers and the consumers they serve. If you’re high-agency, creative in your approach, and known for exceptional follow-through, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Build and own relationships with regulators, government officials, and legislators across the UK and EU, as well as consumer groups, trade associations, financial institutions, and other key stakeholders.

Represent Plaid in industry working groups and policy forums on open banking, open finance, smart data, payments, security, and privacy, making Plaid’s case and spotting opportunities to shape the conversation.

Lead research and analysis that shapes Plaid’s positions on key issues and informs our regulatory engagement and advocacy.

Own the planning and execution of Plaid’s UK and EU policy agenda, coordinating projects with internal and external stakeholders.

Partner with teams across Legal, Compliance, Communications, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Sales on shared initiatives.

Stay ahead of emerging policy trends in the UK and EU, flagging risks and opportunities for Plaid’s business and recommending strategies for engagement.

Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer, with the flexibility and confidence to work across diseases within the neurology and hematology therapeutic area. This role includes the opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s expanding portfolio, which spans from rare genetic to common diseases.

Qualifications

  • MD with strong research background or MD PhD with best of class clinical and/or research training as shown through research support and peer-reviewed publications.
  • Board Certification (or equivalent) or specialist training in hematology is desirable
  • 3+ ye

jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description:
What Quadrants is  Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.  The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.  It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.  The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role  You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.  Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.  It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.  The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.  Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

API & authoring experience.  The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

jobs.description:
What we're building  Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World  is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from  Genesis AI . One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available ( paper ). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.  Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.  This is at  the core of Genesis AI's strategy . Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role  You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Speed.  Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

Completeness.  No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

Fidelity.  More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

Versatility.  Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is  traceable and transparent .  We're a  160+ person  team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a  $75M Series B  round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over  4,000 UK businesses  across  8,500+ sites ,  with over £75m  in value returned to businesses and generators so far.  We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.  The industry is noticing. We were crowned  Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company  at the  GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at  #6  on  LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026  in the UK,  #7  on the  Scaling Europe 50  of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and  #14  on  Sifted's AI 100 .  Learn more about us on our  website .

🏅 The Role:

We're hiring a Staff Machine Learning Engineer (L4) for Pricing in Rosso.  Rosso is tem's core IP. It forecasts prices and volumes, holds a live view of our portfolio, and sets the fees on every quote. You'll join the pricing ML team and own key components of our dynamic pricing system. The direction is set. Within your components, choosing the bets and proving whether they worked is yours. This is a hands-on role. Most of your week will be writing and shipping production code, and you'll stay accountable for what that code does once it's live.  You will:

Own key components of our dynamic pricing system end to end, from design through to running them in production.

Choose the bets within those components most likely to reduce sales adjustment, and show whether they worked.

Make your components observable, guarded and replayable, so a wrong price is caught before a customer sees it.

Unblock your own delivery across engineering, platform and commercial teams.

You will report into the ML Leader for Rosso.

🚀 Responsibilities:

Own key components of dynamic pricing

Take ownership of one or more core components, such as the models that learn from won and lost deals, the experimentation and measurement layer, or the live guardrails that keep price changes safe.

Within your components, choose between competing bets based on which is most likely to move the metric, and stop the ones that don't.

jobs.title: Talent Analyst Specialist (Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence  is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Talent Analyst Specialist

Remote (Philippines) | Reports to: VP of People

ABOUT THE ROLE

We hire fast, and we're getting bigger every quarter. That only works if the people making hiring decisions can see clearly. Which channels produce great candidates. Where offers stall. How headcount plans track against budget. What our employer brand actually says to the market.

This role builds that clarity. You'll stand up the talent analytics function from the ground up, set the data standards our hiring systems run on, and design the collateral that helps strong candidates say yes. It's part analyst, part systems owner, part brand builder, and you'll be the person leadership comes to when they want a real answer about hiring.

The work is hard for a good reason. Talent data lives across an ATS, an HRIS, sourcing tools, a finance model, and more spreadsheets than anyone wants to admit, and none of them fully agree with each other. You'll decide what good data looks like, get the organization to hold that standard, and turn it into reporting people actually open on a Monday morning. You'll also own the story we tell candidates, and you'll know whether that story is working because you'll be measuring it.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Talent Analytics

Build the talent analytics function at Luxury Presence, from metric definitions through to the dashboards recruiters and leaders use every week

Define the talent KPIs that matter, including time to fill, pipeline conversion, source quality, offer acceptance, and quality of hire, and set the targets we hold ourselves to

Automate reporting so it refreshes itself and nobody spends Friday rebuilding a deck by hand

Bring analysis to leadership with a recommendation attached, not just a chart

Data Governance

Develop and implement data quality standards across the full talent tool stack

Own field definitions, required data, and naming conventions, then run the audits that keep them honest

Partner with the teams who own our systems and integrations to close gaps at the source rather than patching them downstream

Make our talent data trustworthy enough that Finance and leadership plan from it without checking it twice

Workforce Planning

Partner with Finance to track and forecast headcount, and keep one source of truth for approved, open, and filled roles

Build the workforce analytics that connect hiring activity to plan, budget, and capacity

Surface variances early, with enough context for leaders to act on them

Employer Brand and Talent Collateral

Manage the full lifecycle of our employer branding assets, from creation through refresh and retirement

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Personalization & Predictions
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier  agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the

entire

customer journey.

We're taking  autonomous search  mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.

We’re making  conversational shopping  a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.

We're designing the future of  autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine —  Loomi  — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

You'd be joining the  Artificial Intelligence team . We own the algorithmic core of the platform: Predictions, Contextual Personalization, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, and the agentic workflows behind Loomi. We work with behavioural data at terabyte scale, across 1,400+ customers, in production, every day. We are currently allowing flexibility for our employees to work from anywhere for the respective region  (Central & Eastern Europe)  or we are happy to  meet you in our offices in Bratislava (Slovakia) or Brno, Prague (Czechia) on a full-time basis.

The mission

You find the signal in how 1,400 brands' customers actually behave — and you prove it moved a business metric.  Your models decide which customers are predicted to churn, which segments form themselves, which offer a shopper sees, and whether the discount changed anything or was going to convert anyway.

What you'll actually do

Frame the problem before modelling it.  Most of our highest-impact work arrives as a vague business question, and turning it into something measurable is the first job.

Work the data at scale.  Behavioural data, product catalogues and event streams across BigQuery and Databricks — finding features that carry real predictive signal, not the ones that are easy to compute.

Build and evaluate models  across Predictions and Contextual Personalization: propensity and churn, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, uplift and incrementality.

Design the evaluation, not just the model.  Offline metrics, backtests, and the A/B design that decides whether this ships. You own the question "how would we know if this is worse?"

Bring methods in from outside and judge them honestly  — read the literature, run the quick PoC, and tell a real result from a well-marketed one.

Hand off cleanly to ML Engineering.  You own the model and the evidence;

jobs.title: Senior C++ Engineer, Real-time Engine
jobs.description:

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Job Description

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will:

  • Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D

About the role

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

You Will:

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.
  • Define and lock down every communication path in and out of the sandbox: syscalls, IPC, shared memory, file descriptors, sockets, brokers, and minimize what each one exposes.
  • Enumerate and reduce attack surface: kernel syscall surface, broker interfaces, device access, and side channels. Assume the code inside is hostile.
  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
  • Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. A single well-designed primitive or optimization here makes hundreds of internal engineer

jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer - GPU Systems & Kernels
jobs.description:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to make large-scale model training and inference as fast and efficient as the hardware allows. You will work at the lowest level of our stack, writing and tuning GPU kernels and removing the memory and communication bottlenecks that limit large Mixture-of-Experts models on the latest GPUs.

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security.

Frontier Foundations builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas:

Trained Agents for Observability - Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost.

What You'll Do:

  • Write, tune, and debug GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, or similar) for the operations that dominate LLM training and inference.
  • Optimize for the latest NVIDIA GPU generations, including memory hierarchy, tensor cores, and low-precision formats such as FP8 and FP4
  • Reduce communication cost in distributed workloads (all-to-all, all-reduce) and overlap communication with compute across NVLink and across nodes
  • Profile end-to-end training and rollout workloads to identify whether they are compute-, memory-, or communication-bound, and quantify the headroom
  • Build benchmarks, profiling tools, and regression tests that guide optimization decisions
  • Collaborate with Research Scientists to turn new model architectures into efficient implementations
  • Explore emerging techniques such as low-precision training and serving, speculative decoding, and fused or persistent kernels

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in at least one of: GPU kernel development and optimization (CUDA or similar), low-latency communication and collective operations (e.g., RDMA, NCCL), or large-scale training infrastructure
  • You can reason about hardware constraints (memory, bandwidth, interconnect topology) and explain where a bottleneck is and how you would confirm it
  • You are proficient in a systems language (e.g., C++, Rust, or CUDA C) and in Python
  • You have strong debugging and profiling skills, including tools such as Nsight
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

jobs.description:
You'll ship agents that move money, and you'll keep the rhythm that gets them shipped. Accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury: autonomous agents that read the invoice, match it, negotiate the discount, release the payment, and reconcile the cash. Every one of those actions runs in production with a customer's CFO watching the result.  Most of what the industry calls engineering culture was written for a world where humans typed every line. That world ended. We want to build the 2026 version: engineers who work with agents as a matter of course, where the unit of work is the loop (spec, generate, evaluate, correct, ship) rather than the ticket, where code review means reviewing the evals and prompts as hard as the diff, and where a regression suite over real customer invoices is what lets us move fast on systems that touch money. Nobody has a settled playbook for this. You'll help write ours, from inside a pod.  This is a player-coach role. You'll spend most of your week shipping code in one of our pods, and you'll manage the engineers day to day: 1:1s, feedback, growth, the hard conversation when it's needed. The rest goes to the delivery rhythm: pods commit to milestones in Linear, post progress daily, and review misses every Friday with the Head of Product and the CTO. You run that review and the follow-ups. The management share grows as we go from 8 engineers to 16 and beyond; this role is the natural path to Head of Engineering. You'll report to the CTO. Causa Prima is built by the team behind Taulia and backed by Creandum.

What you'll do

Ship as a senior engineer, 70 to 80% of your week.  Take the hardest work in your pod, unblock the integration nobody wants, and review the code that touches money personally. You set the bar by clearing it in front of the team.

Manage the engineers day to day.  Weekly 1:1s, direct feedback, growth plans, and the honest conversation about who's ready for more scope and who's in the wrong seat. The CTO owns hiring decisions and the technical direction; the people in the pods are yours.

Run the delivery rhythm.  Weekly milestone commitments, the Friday review, the dashboard of committed versus delivered, and the follow-ups when something slips. Misses are discussed to learn, not to blame; your job is that they get discussed at all, with an owner and a next step.

Make the loop the way we work.  Specs written so an agent can execute them, evals that run before merge, review practices that treat prompts as code. The CTO owns the architecture; you own that every pod actually works this way, including the change management when they don't.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Engineer  You'll be the most senior engineer on the agents that run finance operations for our customers — designing, building, and operating the autonomous agents that handle accounts payable and receivable end-to-end. From invoice validation and dispute resolution to cross-company negotiation and cash optimization.  This is an individual-contributor role at the top of our ladder: no direct reports, full technical authority over the architecture the rest of the team builds on.  What you'll do

Agent architecture  — Design the multi-agent system: agent boundaries, event contracts, orchestration patterns, and the separation between LLM reasoning and deterministic enforcement. LLMs inform; rules enforce. You own where that line sits for every action that moves money, and the authorization gateway that makes it non-negotiable.

Agentic dispute resolution  — An agent that reads the claim, gathers the evidence from the PO, contract, and delivery record, forms a position, and works it to settlement — negotiating with the counterparty where that's appropriate, escalating to a human where it isn't. Deductions and short pays classified, tied to the underlying claim, and driven to resolution rather than parked in an aging bucket.

Agentic dynamic discounting  — Agents that continuously price early payment against the cash position on both sides of the transaction, propose terms, and execute them. Static payment terms become a negotiation that runs on its own.

Matching and reconciliation  — Three-way matching across purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice with configurable tolerances; cash application against bank statements and remittance advices, including partial payments and residuals; the exception paths that follow when any of it fails. Unglamorous but important: The foundation everything agentic sits on.

Validation & anomaly detection  — Business rule checks, duplicate and near-duplicate detection, pricing discrepancy detection, and anomaly detection across time. Precision matters as much as recall here: a false positive is a blocked supplier and an angry procurement lead.

Integration framework  — ERP systems first and deepest, then banking APIs, accounting platforms, Gmail, Drive, and Slack. Auth model, credential lifecycle, data normalization. Today each connector is a project; you make the next one a configuration.

Compliance & security  — Agents operate within a zero-trust model. You'll design how agents verify independently against source data, how outbound content is reviewed, and how the system prevents cascading failures from prompt injection. Plus the European e-invoicing mandates now landing across France, Germany, and Spain, and what EN 16931 means for the pipeline.

Platform & data infrastructure  — Own the primitives every agent action rests on: an append-only PostgreSQL event store with tamper-evident hash chaining for replay and audit; cryptographic signature verification on agent events and approval chains before anything

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
No industry is currently being transformed by AI as much as the legal industry.  At JUPUS – one of the fastest-growing legal tech companies in Europe – we are leading this transformation and changing the way lawyers work forever. Our AI software automates the legal workflow – from the initial inquiry to the final written submission. This is how we help law firms work faster, more efficiently, and more scalably than ever before. JUPUS is backed by a Series A.  We are now looking for a Senior Product Manager (m/f/d) who thrives in ambiguity and wants to shape one of the most transformative products in the world with a relentless focus on creating radical value for our customers.

Tasks

Own initiatives end to end:  You take product initiatives from discovery to production, working closely with engineering, design and cross-functional partners. You work across the live product and new initiatives.

Ship in weeks:  We typically go from discovery to solution in 2 to 3 weeks. You imagine ambitious solutions with your team, then scope them to the smallest version that fits the timeline so users benefit early.

Improve what is live:  Live features matter as much as new launches. You improve them continuously based on lawyer feedback and usage data.

Design for the user:  You work with design from the start and shape the user experience, including how AI outputs are presented and how users come to trust them.

Build customer-centric products:  You work closely with lawyers through interviews, research sessions and feedback loops, many of them in German, to understand their workflows, pain points and goals. You turn these insights into clear product opportunities and features.

Measure impact:  You track quantitative and qualitative signals during beta and after release, and use them to decide what to build or change next.

Unlock business value:  You partner with Sales, Customer Success, Operations and other teams so the product supports adoption, retention and revenue growth.

Requirements

Experience

You have 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, including shipping AI or AI-powered features end to end.

You have worked in a startup or scale-up and are used to short development cycles: delivery is cheap, so you scope to the timeline and get value to users fast.

You use AI in your daily work as part of your standard workflow, for example to prototype ideas, explore solutions and test them with users.

You are comfortable moving between strategic thinking, analytical problem solving, and hands-on execution.

You speak fluent English and German (C1 or above), as you will run customer conversations in German.

Bonus:  You have experience in legal tech.

How you work

You are a self-starter. You set your own direction and do not need a roadmap handed to you.

You make decisions with conviction, even without full consensus, and can persuasively bring others along.

You thrive in ambiguity and excel at structuring complex problems, thinking

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Security
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer - Security, you will design, build, and operate the security capabilities that protect Radiant's cloud platform and infrastructure.  You'll work across identity, access control, secrets, network security, platform hardening, auditability, and compliance controls. You'll partner closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, networking, security, and compliance teams, and with customers on their most demanding security requirements.  This is a hands-on engineering role focused on making security embedded, scalable, automated, and easy to consume across the platform. You'll own significant security services from design through production, working alongside our Principal Engineers on their architecture.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and own security services and platform capabilities, and contribute to their architecture and technical designs.

Build core security services across IAM, RBAC, workload identity, secrets, encryption and key management, audit logging, network controls, and policy enforcement.

Turn product, customer, and regulatory requirements into well-designed APIs and implementations, working with the Security Product Manager and Principal Engineers.

Automate policy enforcement, configuration hardening, detection, remediation, and software supply chain security.

Implement strong tenant isolation and least-privilege access across the control plane and network and data plane.

Support enterprise customer security reviews, audits, and incident response.

Contribute to security engineering standards through code review, and support less experienced engineers.

Your Profile

Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

Solid experience building and operating distributed systems, with depth in cloud and network security, IAM, or security infrastructure.

Experience owning significant components end to end, from design through production and operation.

Strong technical knowledge across several of:

Identity & access:  IAM, RBAC/ABAC, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, federation, mTLS, workload and service identity

Security controls:  applied cryptography, encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management, KMS/HSM, key rotation, policy engines

Infrastructure:  Kubernetes internals, containers and runtime isolation, cloud networking, compute, storage

Security operations:  audit logging pipelines, detection engineering, vulnerability management, incident response

Automation:  policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD security, software supply chain (signing, SBOMs, provenance)

Experience with technologies such as Vault, OPA/Gatekeeper, SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes admission control and security tooling, Sigstore, SIEM platforms, cloud KMS, or similar.

Good understanding of multi-tenancy, least privilege, zero-trust architecture, threat modelling, and shared-responsibility models.

Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 2

jobs.title: Recruiter - Games (Contract)

jobs.title: Rendering Technical Artist II - League of Legends (Contract)
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title, League of Legends, to critical and player acclaim. Players form the foundation of our community, and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That’s where you come in.

As a Rendering Technical Artist (Contract) on the Singapore League of Legends PC Team, you’ll help bring the world of Runeterra and beyond to life through materials, lighting, and real-time rendering. League’s visual targets are built on a modern real-time, PBR-based rendering pipeline with stylized, hand-painted treatments, and you’ll author, extend, and maintain the shaders and materials that realize them across champions, skins, and related content.

Working closely with artists, designers, engineers, and external partners, you’ll act as a bridge between art and engineering—translating visual and art-direction goals into robust, performant solutions that behave consistently across around-game and in-game environments. As an experienced technical artist, you’ll also diagnose rendering issues early, reduce rework, and help raise the craft bar for how shaders and materials are authored across internal and external teams.

Reporting to the Technical Art Manager, you will ensure that assets meet technical performance standards and artistic direction requirements. In collaboration with Art, Design, Engineering, and external partners, you will contribute to production support and workflow improvements.

Please note that Riot Games does not offer relocation packages for this position.

Responsibilities:

  • Author, extend, and maintain real-time shaders and materials for League of Legends within a PBR-based rendering workflow, including reusable shader functions and shared material systems that scale across champions and skins.
  • Apply strong PBR fundamentals across albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, ambient occlusion, emissive, lighting, and reflection-probe inputs, ensuring shader features account for the full material response rather than the diffuse channel in isolation.
  • Collaborate directly with Art and Design to understand desired visual behaviors and art direction, and translate them into clear, achievable, and performant rendering solutions.
  • Provide hands-on technical support to internal and external vendor artists, helping them author, integrate, and troubleshoot materials and shaders for Epic and Legendary skins.

jobs.title: Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Riot Anti-Cheat Engineers are versatile and passionate about their craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s client services. With versatility across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling services, you’ll work primarily in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly to build new anti-cheat features, improve the security and reliability of existing systems, and debug complex behavior across the Windows stack. You’ll also reverse engineer emerging cheats, including packed and obfuscated binaries, and rapidly translate those findings into practical detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. You'll be based in our Santa Monica, CA office and work in a hybrid (work-from-home and in-office) environment. You'll report to the Sr. Manager of Anti-Cheat Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and drive high impact anti-cheat features from ambiguity to production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
  • Move fast to turn emerging threats into resilient detections or preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed with agility at scale.
  • Think ahead to design and develop capabilities that anticipate the cheaters next move or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Reverse engineer highly evasive cheats and operating system manipulation techniques
  • Investigate and resolve complex compatibility issues in highly opaque environments
  • Support game teams directly in understanding cheating ecosystems and integrating Anti-Cheat

Required Qualifications:

  • Proficient in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly
  • Experience building and debugging low-level, security-sensitive systems
  • Strong understanding of Windows process internals, including process and thread lifecycles, virtual memory, handles and objects, security contexts, executable image formats, DLL loading, and the Windows loader
  • Hands-on reverse engineering experience, including analyzing packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries and identifying techniques used to conceal or manipulate runtime behavior
  • Practical understanding of the Windows kernel and driver model, with demonstrated experience developing, debugging, and maintaining production grade kernel-mode drivers.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience within cheat-development or game-security research communities, with practical knowledge of modern cheat techniques

你将与游戏设计、美术、叙事、动画、工程等团队紧密合作。

这不仅是一个“制作声音资产”的岗位。你需要理解为什么需要这个声音、玩家什么时候听到它，以及它如何服务于玩法和体验。

主要职责

  • 负责游戏中音效的设计、制作与实现。
  • 根据玩法目标和玩家体验，建立清晰、有辨识度且具有情绪表现力的声音语言。
  • 参与游戏音乐设计。
  • 使用 Wwise / FMOD / Unreal / Unity 或内部引擎完成音频资产的游戏内实现。
  • 设计音乐与音效的state、Transition、Layer、Trigger及其他交互逻辑。
  • 与 Game Design、Art、Narrative、Animation、Engineering 等团队合作，将抽象体验目标转化为可执行的音频方案。
  • 在保证艺术品质的同时，关注玩法信息传达、声音层级、可读性以及游戏性能。
  • 主动根据玩家反馈、测试结果和团队反馈持续迭代。
  • 与外部作曲家、录音师、音频供应商等合作，并能够提供明确、有效的创作反馈。

任职要求

  • 具备成熟的游戏音效设计与制作能力，能够独立完成从概念到游戏内落地的完整流程。
  • 熟练使用主流 DAW 及声音设计工具，如 Pro Tools、Reaper、Nuendo、Ableton、iZotope 等。
  • 熟悉 Wwise / FMOD 等音频中间件，并具备实际游戏项目实施经验。
  • 理解游戏引擎中的音频工作方式，具备 Unreal、Unity 或其他商业/自研引擎经验。
  • 对Gameplay Feedback、声音层级、空间音频和交互式音频系统有深入理解。
  • 能够理解产品和设计目标，而不是仅从单一声音资产的品质出发进行设计。
  • 具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能够清晰表达设计意图，并处理来自不同专业方向的反馈和分歧。

我们尤其看重

  • 能够从玩家体验而不是单纯从音频专业角度判断方案。
  • 能够解释自己的设计决策，而不仅仅依赖个人审美。
  • 面对设计、工程或制作限制时，能够找到体验、品质和成本之间的合理平衡。
  • 能够主动发现体验问题，并推动相关团队一起解决。

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Creative Management - Wild Rift
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

If the Creative/Art Directors are the 'Why' & the 'What', this role owns the 'How' and the 'Who'. You will lean on your years of experience to help manage one of the most ambitious, high-stakes creative teams in the industry, building some of the most robust, scalable systems, collaborative partnerships, and player-focused content.

You will work with Product Leads, Delivery Leads, Stakeholders, and the Game Director to stay aligned on vision and priorities while maintaining consistent art quality and style across the team and pipelines. The role does not create the creative direction or art vision, but oversees its execution and the evolution of art pipelines and the creative team.

  • Translate vision into actionable goals ensuring consistent alignment across each creative discipline.
  • Oversee the creation of high-quality creative content that upholds our creative vision and elevates the player experience. Step in to provide creative direction when needed to guide decisions, resolve conflicts, and model excellence, while prioritizing team growth over hands-on execution.

jobs.title: 中国区周边消费品业务销售运营经理 (Contract)
jobs.description:
拳头游戏（Riot Games）由一群富有创业精神的硬核玩家于2006年创立。我们坚信“玩家优先”的理念能够造就伟大的游戏。我们的首款游戏《英雄联盟》（League of Legends）于2009年发行，赢得了业界与玩家的广泛赞誉。如今，它已成为全球最受欢迎的电子游戏之一，月活跃玩家超过一亿。

在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。

关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。

你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。

核心职责

  • 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。
  • 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。
  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。
  • 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 8年以上B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。
  • 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。
  • 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。
  • 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。
  • 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。
  • 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。

加分项（期待条件）

  • 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。
  • 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！
