jobs.title: Entrepreneur Intern
jobs.description:
About SeeSicht Gmbh  SeeSicht is a small family office of AI-first companies. We build companies that are profitable today and keep them for the long term — not a venture builder chasing funding rounds. Every project is funded 100% by me or by me and my network. No investor search, no fundraising rounds.  Your first months at SeeSicht Gmbh  You will take on core business development tasks, working alongside experienced team members to support company initiatives. Through daily operations, you will learn how the business scales and manage assigned projects within a hybrid work environment.  What you will do

You execute. I bring the ideas, the network and the money — you turn them into real products, pages, campaigns and processes.

You build and test the way we always do it: build a sellable prototype (CHF 100–1,000), test it on the market with Facebook ads (CHF 5,000–10,000), build the product fully (CHF 10,000–20,000), then launch with real marketing spend.

MyBikePlan is the proof: 2019 idea, one-week website, one week of Facebook marketing, CHF 500 invested → 30 pre-orders. 2020 launch with CHF 1M in the first year, 2021 team, 2025 sold close to CHF 20M. The playbook is set — you run it on new projects.

Current projects: Fairbroker.ch (AI insurance broker, market test now, live Q1 2027), a kettlebell workout app (52-card deck, early prototype, suppliers in China secured), and Glanzio (B2B store-window cleaning, launch test Q1 2027).

The timeline — how it works

Months 1–12 — the internship:  CHF 2,500/month, full-time, paid, and inside that year up to 10% of the profit of the project/company you work on.

From month 13 — the stake:  the internship is over and you get a stake in the company, up to 10% equity, with a base salary of at least CHF 5,000/month — plus the up to 10% profit share on top. If a project becomes a real company, a senior position is possible, depending on how you develop.

What you get from day 1

All the AI tools

A company laptop

A place to work and a structure from day 1

Me, coaching and strategising side by side with you

Who we're looking for (requirements)

You're finishing or just finished university.

Two of these skills are genuinely strong, the rest you understand and want to grow: marketing, operations/service design, design, UX, AI usage.

You work the way we work: Lovable, Claude and Airtable — that's the whole stack. If something is missing, you say why and it gets added.

You're transparent, fast and smart.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Role

Most of what makes Together AI so valuable for customers is invisible from the outside. Optimizing kernels, scheduling, quantization, speculative decoding, and more create an industry-leading platform for inference and post-training at scale. As a technical marketing engineer, you are the conduit between the engineering and research work and the developers who should know about it. You go deep with product, engineering, research, and CX to learn the platform at the level of nuanced technical detail, then decide which details matter to an AI builder and build content that makes them care.

This is a creator role. You are a technical storyteller. You'll produce social-native posts, technical blogs, performance benchmarks, demo and explainer videos, and thought leadership, all aimed at one outcome: building Together’s credibility with developers. You'll also own our technical communities on X, YouTube, Discord, Linkedin and the engagement metrics for developer content company-wide, including amplifying the work of engineers and researchers who publish under their own names.

Responsibilities

External

  • Partner with product, engineering, DevRel, research, and CX to learn new capabilities in technical depth, then extract the most meaningful aspects for a developer audience.
  • Create the content strategy based on deep understanding of our company’s differentiation and marries that with an understanding of the content that would resonate.
  • Build technical content across formats: blogs, videos, benchmark reports, podcasts, and short-form posts that drive engagement with developers and preference for Together.
  • Monitor real-time news and announcements related to AI infrastructure and lead timely responses working with product and engineering
  • Replies to social media comments, bringing expert understanding of the technology
  • Own Together's presence in technical communities, primarily X, Discord, LinkedIn, and Youtube. Track engagement metrics, what lands, what doesn't, and adjust.
  • Drive amplification of engineering and research work across social channels.
  • Be the heartbeat of the Together AI technical community - understanding the developers and researchers who follow us and enabling them to be successful
  • Experiment and test new ideas to see what resonates with the community
  • While the role involved mainly online engagement (80%), there is an aspect of translating their deep understanding to deliver highly engaging in-person meet ups and events (20%) in collaboration with Events/ DevRel teams

Internal

  • Be the bridge between research and engineering with the field team
  • Deploy models, benchmark new capabilities (e.g. the compiler, speculative decoding) across models and workloads, and turn results into practical field guidance

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

Alexis Soulopoulos  [CEO]

Your Role  Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on  self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models . On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models.  Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by  Marco, our LLM Tech Lead , working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across  data, post-training, evals, and model behavior,  taking ideas from failure analysis to production.  The problems are real:  personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

Fine-tune open-weight LLMs  using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments.  Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

Build training data and evals  that directly shape what gets trained next

Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.  Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.  Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity  Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

The Role  As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Build next-generation neural a

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are  Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.  Role summary  Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.  The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.  You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.  What you will own  Core security leadership (about half)

Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.  Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.  Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.  Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.  Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.  Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.  Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the comp

Van medische apparatuur en industriële automatisering tot semicon-oplossingen: achter ieder succesvol high-tech product schuilt sterke software. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt jij je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar bouw je ook aan de softwareorganisatie van morgen. Je creëert een omgeving waarin vakmanschap, kennisdeling, innovatie en continue verbetering centraal staan. Daarnaast volg je technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en stimuleer je de inzet van moderne technologieën om softwareontwikkeling slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 45 embedded software engineers en ondersteunt hen in hun professionele en persoonlijke groei.

Je geeft richting aan AI-gedreven transformatie binnen het softwareteam én de bredere organisatie, en neemt je team en collega’s mee in nieuwe manieren van werken.

Je stimuleert een cultuur van technische excellentie, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Je zorgt voor de juiste balans tussen projectresultaten, de ontwikkeling van je team en langetermijndoelstellingen.

Je werkt samen met architecten, technical leads en projectteams aan de verdere professionalisering van softwareontwikkeling binnen Benchmark.

Je bewaakt de benodigde capaciteit, competenties en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

Je speelt een actieve rol in het aantrekken, ontwikkelen en behouden van softwaretalent.

Je versterkt de samenwerking met internationale engineeringteams binnen Benchmark.

Je vertegenwoordigt Software Engineering binnen het Competence Management Team en levert een actieve bijdrage aan organisatiebrede besluitvorming.

Je stimuleert het gebruik van moderne ontwikkelmethodieken en tooling om kwaliteit, productiviteit en innovatie te versterken.

Je vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, werkwijzen en engineering excellence.

Samen met de managers van Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan een toekomstbestendige engineeringorganisatie. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om samenwerking tussen disciplines te versterken en technologische ontwikkelingen succesvol naar de praktijk te vertalen.

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van people leade

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Switzerland.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR

Als stagiair Business Control draai je actief mee binnen het financiële team van Berenschot. Je ondersteunt de business controllers bij het analyseren van prestaties, het voorbereiden van rapportages en het signaleren van ontwikkelingen die van belang zijn voor de organisatie.

jobs.title: [AI Frontier Div.] AI Inference Platform & Operations Lead (10년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤의 AI 기술을 실제 제품과 서비스로 연결하고, 새로운 사업 기회를 검증하고 확장하는 조직입니다. 여러 Squad가 서로 다른 고객과 시장을 대상으로 사업을 추진하며, 각 Squad는 제품 개발부터 서비스 운영과 사업 성과까지 책임집니다. 고객의 요구와 실제 사용 결과를 바탕으로 제품을 개선하고, 사업성이 확인된 서비스를 확장해 나갑니다.
  • AI Inference Platform & Operations 팀은 이러한 제품들이 공통으로 사용하는 추론 기반을 만들고, 이를 바탕으로 외부 고객에게 제공하는 추론 서비스를 구축·운영합니다. 자체 모델과 오픈웨이트 모델을 빠르고 안정적으로 서비스에 연결하고, 트래픽이 성장해도 일관된 응답 속도와 가용성을 유지하며, GPU 자원과 추론 비용을 효율적으로 운영하는 것이 팀의 미션입니다.
  • AI Frontier 본부 구성원들은 직급과 연차에 상관없이 의견을 내고, 결정하면 빠르게 실행합니다. 장애를 겪으면 숨기지 않고 포스트모템으로 시스템을 더 단단하게 만들고, 아키텍처와 실험 결과와 의사결정 과정을 문서로 남깁니다. AI 도구를 일상적인 개발·운영 도구로 쓰며, 새로운 모델과 서빙 기술이 나오면 바로 써보고 프로덕션에 적용할 방법을 찾는 문화를 지향합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • Inference fleet과 control plane 소유
    • 추론 플랫폼의 기술 방향과 주요 기술 의사결정을 책임지는 Lead로서 자체 모델과 오픈웨이트 모델(음성·멀티모달 포함)을 위한 서빙 플랫폼을 설계하고, 구축·운영 체계를 수립하며 팀의 실행을 이끕니다.
    • 서빙 엔진과 오케스트레이션 계층을 선택하고, 요청 라우팅, 용량·모델·캐시 배치, 오토스케일링, 멀티 모델·멀티 테넌트 운영 정책을 포함한 기술 로드맵과 운영 표준을 수립합니다.
  • 조직 구축과 협업 구조 정립
    • 팀을 직접 채용·육성하고, AI Research의 컴퓨팅 최적화 R&D 조직, 사내 추론 서비스를 운영하는 IT 조직, 각 사업 Squad 사이의 단일 접점 역할을 합니다.
    • 프로덕션의 워크로드 프로파일과 병목을 R&D 요구사항으로 구체화하고, 연구 결과를 검증·인수·배포하는 루프를 만듭니다.
  • 안전한 모델 온보딩과 플랫폼 경험 제공
    • 새 모델의 성능·품질 회귀 테스트, 릴리즈 자동화, 카나리·롤백, API gateway의 인증·쿼터·rate limit, 토큰 단위 관측성을 구축합니다.
    • 사업 Squad와 모델 개발자가 모델을 빠르고 일관되게 온보딩할 수 있는 셀프서비스 도구와 가이드를 제공합니다.
  • SLO와 운영 신뢰성 확립
    • TTFT·TPOT·end-to-end latency의 p95·p99, 가용성, 에러율, 처리량 등 워크로드별 SLO와 error budget을 각 Squad와 함께 정합니다.
    • 온콜, 장애 대응, 포스트모템, capacity event 대응, deploy safety를 포함한 운영

jobs.title: AI Safety Residency - SLPreP
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with Scale Labs Preparedness and Policy (SLPreP), we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

The work includes thinking about various failure modes, evaluating whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Residents take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide AI safety residents on projects in AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AI systems, including monitoring their reasoning to detect harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment red-teaming: Developing science around testing whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: Examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: A benchmark with task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: evaluating whether language models choose harmful actions when given simulated dangerous tools under various operational pressures
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.
  • RSI Control: evaluating whether frontier models can covertly sabotage R&D efforts in the RSI loop.

jobs.title: Technical Revenue Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Scale is looking for a Technical Revenue Accounting Manager to join our growing accounting team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You will ensure revenue is recorded accurately and on time, support the monthly close, and review contracts both during negotiation and after signature. You will also work on new accounting standards and complex transactions, with room to keep building your technical skills.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, self-motivated team player with strong U.S. GAAP and ASC 606 expertise, a passion for delivering quality results, and a track record of turning technical research into practical solutions.

You will:

  • Drive process improvement: Identify and implement process improvements that keep pace with our growth and scale with the business
  • External audit: Work with external auditors on revenue and technical accounting matters

High-velocity:  Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤의 AI 기술을 실제 제품과 서비스로 연결하고, 새로운 사업 기회를 검증하고 확장하는 조직입니다. 여러 Squad가 서로 다른 고객과 시장을 대상으로 사업을 추진하며, 각 Squad는 제품 개발부터 서비스 운영과 사업 성과까지 책임집니다. 고객의 요구와 실제 사용 결과를 바탕으로 제품을 개선하고, 사업성이 확인된 서비스를 확장해 나갑니다.
  • AI Product Dev Chapter는 소속 엔지니어들의 기술 역량과 성장을 책임지는 조직입니다. 각 스쿼드의 PO가 제품과 사업을 이끌고, 챕터는 기술 방향·개발 품질·공통 기반·인재 육성을 맡습니다. 스쿼드가 개발·운영하는 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. 챕터의 목표는 스쿼드의 AI 기술이 고객 가치와 매출로 이어지는 속도를 높이는 것입니다.
  • 스쿼드가 만드는 AI 제품 중 일부는 실제 고객에게 출시해 운영하는 단계에 들어서고 있습니다. 고객 요구에 맞는 기능을 적시에 출시하려면 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 정하고, 제품 품질과 운영 비용을 고려해 기술적 병목을 해결해야 합니다. 챕터는 PO와 함께 이 과정을 이끌고, 여러 스쿼드에서 얻은 경험을 본부 공통의 개발 역량으로 발전시켜 갑니다.
  • 이번에 합류하실 분은 챕터장으로서 제품별 기술 의사결정과 공통 개발·검증 체계를 이끌고, 엔지니어를 채용·육성하며 챕터의 일하는 방식을 만들어 갑니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 제품 기술 의사결정: PO와 함께 고객 요구를 기술 과제로 구체화하고, 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 조율합니다. 스쿼드별 기술 스택이 파편화되지 않도록 각 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. PoC가 프로덕션 전환까지 이어지도록 중요한 기술 병목은 직접 설계 검토와 프로토타이핑에 참여해 해결합니다.
  • AI 기술 PoC와 품질 검증: 새로운 모델·API를 빠르게 비교 평가할 수 있는 PoC 환경을 만들고, AI 기능을 실제 사용 시나리오와 데이터로 평가합니다. 실패 사례와 변경 전후의 품질·응답 속도·비용을 비교해 제품 개선으로 연결합니다. 평가는 고객이 비용을 내고 쓸 품질인지까지 확인하고, 결과는 PO가 사업 판단에 쓸 수 있게 정리합니다.
  • AI 기반 개발 생산성: AI 코딩 도구가 코드베이스와 제품의 맥락, 개발 규칙을 이해하고 테스트 작성·배포 설정 같은 반복 작업을 맡을 수 있도록 개발 환경을 갖춥니다. AI가 만든 코드와 설계를 사람이 판단할 리뷰 기준을 세우고, 테스트 자동화로 빠르게 검증할 수 있게 합니다. 새로운 AI 개발 도구는 생산성·품질·보안 기준으로 평가해 도입하고, 구성원이 찾은 좋은 방법은 가이드와 세미나로 스쿼드 전체에 퍼뜨립니다.
  • 공통 개발·운영 기반: 반복 개발 비용을 줄이고 새 기능을 빠르게 출시할 수 있도록 개발 템플릿, CI/CD, 클라우드, 모니터링 등 공통 기반을 만듭니다. 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 적용 범위와 유지보수 담당을 정하고, 쌓이는 기술 부채를 찾아 해결합니다. 제품 출시와 운영을 위해 인프라·보안 등 다양한 부서와 협업해 안정성과 비용 효율을 높입니다.
  • 엔지니어 채용·성장·평가: 사업 계획에 필요한 엔지니어 역량을 정리하고, 이를 검증할 JD·기술 과제·면접 기준을 만들어 채용과 온보딩을 주도합니다. 정기 1on1·멘토링과 테크 토크·코드 리뷰로 구성원의 성장을 돕고 스쿼드 간 기술을 공유합니다. PO와 협력해 실제 기여에 근거한 성과 평가와 경력 개발을 이끕니다.

jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤이 보유한 AI 기술과 선행 R&D 자산을 기반으로 새로운 제품과 사업을 만드는 조직입니다. AI Model과 Agent의 가능성을 실제 고객의 문제와 연결하며, 게임과 비게임 영역에서 끊임없이 0→1을 시도합니다.
  • 우리는 아직 가능성이 분명하지 않은 영역에서도 작은 기회를 발견하고, 고객과 파트너, 기술과 자원을 연결해 지속 가능한 사업으로 성장할 조건을 만들어갑니다.
  • AI Business Development는 이 과정에서 사업의 동력을 만드는 역할입니다. 제품이 완성되기 전부터 고객과 대화하며 수요를 검증하고, 파트너십과 사업모델을 설계해 실제 계약과 매출로 연결합니다. Product Owner와 함께 사업 전체를 바라보며, 새로운 사업이 실행되고 성장하는 데 필요한 기회를 만들어갈 분을 찾습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 신규 사업 기회 발굴 및 GTM 실행
    • AI 기술·R&D 자산과 고객의 문제를 연결해 사업 가설을 수립하고, 초기 시장 진입부터 사업화까지 추진합니다.
  • 초기 고객 개발 및 수요 검증
    • 제품 기획 단계부터 잠재 고객에게 직접 접근해 실제 과제와 도입 조건을 파악하고, 공동 개발·PoC·구매 등 구체적인 참여를 이끌어냅니다.
  • 전략적 파트너십 및 사업 기반 확보
    • 사업에 필요한 고객 접점, 기술, 데이터, 유통 역량을 가진 파트너를 발굴하고, 상호 이해관계를 반영한 협력 구조를 설계·실행합니다.
  • 사업모델 설계 및 매출 계약 리드
    • 고객 가치와 제공 비용을 바탕으로 사업모델과 가격 정책을 설계하고, 제안·협상·계약부터 후속 사업 확장까지 주도합니다.
  • PO와 함께 사업화 실행
    • 고객 요구와 사업 조건을 제품 범위·우선순위·일정에 연결하고, PO 및 개발·연구 조직과 함께 출시·고객 도입·운영을 추진합니다.
  • 사업 추진의 장애물 해결
    • 기술·데이터·보안·법무 등 주요 제약에 대한 대안을 마련하고, 내외부 이해관계자의 의사결정과 필요한 자원을 확보해 사업을 전진시킵니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 사업 전략 또는 사업개발을 주도해 실질적인 성과를 내고, 조직 성장을 리딩한 경험이 있으신 분

  • 불확실한 환경에서 스스로 사업 기회를 발굴하고, 제품이 완성

jobs.title: Creative Advisor - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.description:
About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI. As a Creative Advisor, you’ll bring your creative practice into direct collaboration with Scale’s research and ML teams. You’ll help them understand how work gets made in your field, develop new work together, and provide feedback on how AI models support—or fall short of—real creative processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Connect with other creators: Meet and learn from creatives and researchers across HFC and your industry.
  • Shape work in your domain: Share the taste, judgment, methods, and creative decisions behind your practice to help inform model development.
  • Create alongside the team: Collaborate on briefs and develop new work that helps explore what models can and cannot do in your field.
  • Partner with ML and research teams: Define what “good” looks like in your field, review model outputs, flag where AI falls short, and give feedback that shapes how models learn your craft.
  • Help peers understand the opportunity: Introduce other creators in your field to the program and share your experience contributing work.

Who Should Apply

We’re looking for leading creators in their field who are interested in shaping AI and how it’s changing creative work. No AI experience needed. Your expertise in your craft matters most, and being connected to others in your field is a plus. This is a paid, part-time role with a flexible schedule.

Why Join

  • Have a voice: Contribute your subject-matter expertise and perspective in your domain. Build the future by shaping frontier models.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with ML and research teams and connect with other leading creatives.
  • Explore new creative possibilities: Make new work through paid, commissioned briefs that challenge what models are capable of doing.
  • Get paid for your expertise: Paid $300 hourly, with compensation, time commitment, and project scope shared during your interview.

Application Process

  1. Apply: Share your background and a link to your portfolio. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
  2. Portfolio Review: Share one past project you’re proud of. Nothing is used without a signed agreement and payment, and we’ll follow up with next steps.
  3. Meet the Team: A paid conversation with our research and ML team to walk through your work.
  4. Get Started: Successful candidates are invited to join the Human Frontier Collective as a Creative Advisor.

About Scale AI

Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with the world's leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI transformation through frontier AI systems that solve real business problems.

Every day, we work with organizations across finance, healthcare, manufacturing, media and telecommunications to build production AI agents that automate complex workflows, help humans, reason over enterprise knowledge, and operate safely at scale.

The Opportunity

Applied AI is moving faster than ever. New foundation models, reasoning techniques, agent architectures, and research papers emerge every week. Yet building AI systems that reliably solve real-world problems remains one of the hardest engineering challenges.

As a Frontier Agent Engineer (Applied AI), you'll bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production deployment. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, evaluate, and deploy intelligent systems that combine frontier models with structured knowledge, retrieval, traditional machine learning, and enterprise software.

Unlike traditional ML roles that focus on a single model or product, you'll work across a diverse portfolio of AI challenges spanning multiple industries and use cases. You may build a multi-agent research system and then participate in designing a customer intelligence platform, a healthcare copilot, or an autonomous workflow for a Fortune 100 company.

Frontier AI Systems

  • Engineer customer intelligence layers, retrieval pipelines, memory systems, and knowledge representations that allow agents to reason over large, heterogeneous enterprise data.
  • Develop multi-agent systems that coordinate reasoning, planning, tool execution, and human oversight.
  • Translate frontier AI research into production systems by rapidly evaluating new models, prompting techniques, reasoning paradigms, and agent architectures.

Experimentation & Evaluation

As a Frontier Data Strategist on Scale's Generative AI team, you'll be a trusted voice in those decisions. The goal of a Machine Learning Engineer at Scale is to leverage techniques in the fields of generative AI, computer vision, reinforcement learning, and agentic AI to improve Scale's products and customer experience in production environments. Our machine learning engineers take advantage of robust internal infrastructure and unique access to massive datasets to deliver improvements to our customers.

Our Public Sector Machine Learning team is focused on deploying cutting-edge models to mission-critical government systems through products like Donovan and Thunderforge. Our work spans multiple modalities, with a strong focus on both large language models and computer vision. On the LLM side, we are developing agentic systems that help solve complex operational and planning challenges for government partners. This includes building agent frameworks that integrate with custom retrieval pipelines and production APIs, as well as evaluation tools to benchmark and refine agent behavior. We're also advancing research in areas like reinforcement learning for agentic LLMs, with successful deployment into real-world operational environments. On the computer vision front, we're training advanced models to increase labeling throughput and automate perception tasks. Our efforts include building large-scale fine-tuning pipelines, training models across multiple modalities, and developing generalizable vision foundation models to support a wide range of defense applications.

You will:

  • Improve and maintain production models through retraining, hyperparameter tuning, and architectural updates, while preserving core performance characteristics
  • Collaborate with product and research teams to identify and prototype ML-driven product enhancements, including for upcoming product lines
  • Work with massive datasets to develop both generic models as well as fine tune models for specific products
  • Build scalable machine learning infrastructure to automate and optimize our ML services

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.
We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force.

Scale's Machine Learning Research team builds the foundation for the next generation of AI systems — pushing the boundaries of what's possible with frontier models while ensuring safety, reliability, and alignment at every step. Our work spans generative AI, reinforcement learning and advanced post-training methods, scalable oversight, synthetic data pipelines, red teaming, and evaluation science.

We are developing a large-scale hybrid human-machine system to power machine learning pipelines for dozens of industry-leading customers. These models and systems form the backbone of Scale's long-term strategy, enabling billions of tasks monthly and supporting some of the most complex and advanced use cases in the AI ecosystem.

As an intern, you'll work on a combination of deeply technical ML applications in production and cutting-edge research problems, with mentorship from world-class researchers and the opportunity to collaborate with leading teams across industry and academia. Interns own real, published or shipped work — not side projects.

Example Projects

  • Measure the dangerous capabilities of frontier models and conduct preparedness research
  • Research the science and creation of new benchmarks for frontier models
  • Develop new methods for training models to excel on extremely difficult reasoning problems that require long chains of thought
  • Research reinforcement learning and post-training methods that improve model reliability on high-stakes tasks
  • Research scalable oversight protocols that enable humans to produce and quality control reasoning chains beyond their native capabilities
  • Study the boundaries of model generalization and capabilities to inform data-driven advancements
  • Research synthetic and hybrid data with humans in the loop to scale up high-quality data generation
  • Take models currently in production, identify areas for improvement, improve them using retraining and hyperparameter searches, then deploy without regressing on core model characteristics
  • Create post-training or agentic solutions that integrate into our ability to deliver applications for enterprise and public sector clients

Required to Have

  • Currently enrolled in a BS, MS or PhD program with a focus on Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Natural Language Processing, with a graduation date in Fall 2

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Scientist, Evaluations
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Scale works with the industry's leading AI labs to provide high quality data and accelerate progress in GenAI research. We are looking for Research Scientists and Research Engineers with expertise in LLM post-training (SFT, RLHF, reward modeling) and evaluation. This role is on the evaluation pod within the GenAI Research Organization and will focus on building benchmarks and diagnosing model failure modes in both text and multimodal modalities.

In this role, you will develop rigorous evaluations and diagnostic methods that reveal where frontier models fail and why. You will collaborate with researchers and engineers to define best practices in evaluation-driven AI development. You will also partner with top foundation model labs to translate failure analysis into technical and strategic input on the next generation of generative AI models.

You will:

jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise Core Platform
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Scale is building the agentic operating system that powers AI deployment across the world's most important organizations. The Platform PM is the person who determines what that foundation needs to be — and holds the bar on how well it gets built.

This is not a roadmap PM, a program manager, or a feature tracker. The Platform PM owns the core infrastructure that every FD team builds on top of: defining the foundation before anything else can be built reliably, sequencing work against real customer commitments and FD team velocity, identifying which FD-built patterns are ready to graduate to core, and ensuring that every capability that ships does so at a bar customers can trust without thinking about it.

The best Platform PMs have defined platform capabilities at production bar in high-stakes environments and understand the difference between what is necessary to build, what is interesting to build, and what should never be built at all.

What You'll Do

  • Define the foundation. Determine what needs to be true at the core platform layer — across each capability pillar — before anything reliable can be built on top of it.
  • Sequence it. Prioritize and order platform work given customer commitments, FD team velocity needs, and what is actually blocking progress today. Getting this wrong means building on an unstable base or building the right things in the wrong order and paying for it in rework and FD team drag.
  • Identify patterns and graduate capabilities. Watch what FD teams are building across the application layer, determine what is genuinely repeating, and make the call on what moves to core — and when. Do not rush graduation or delay it out of caution.
  • Hold the quality bar. Every capability on the platform roadmap earns its place twice: once by being necessary, and again by being done well enough that customers trust it without thinking about it. Keep the platform from becoming a graveyard of half-built capabilities.
  • Unlock delivery team time to value. Forward deployed delivery teams should spend their time solving the hardest customer problems, not rebuilding plumbing on every engagement. That requires a platform that is secure by default, deployable anywhere, observable in production, and equipped with the agentic primitives, eval infrastructure, expert judgment capture, and data reasoning capabilities that every agent workload needs.
  • Partner across the organization. Work closely with platform engineering, forward deployed PMs, and BU leads to surface signal, resolve sequencing tradeoffs, and keep the roadmap grounded in what is actually blocking work.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 6+ years in product management with meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products at production bar.

About Scale

Scale builds AI systems for decisions that matter. We started out providing the data and evaluation behind many of the world's leading models, and we still work with the major frontier labs on research and post-training. Today we also build full applications: we take an organisation's own data and expertise, forward deploy alongside their teams, and build the systems they come to rely on, powered by the Scale GenAI Platform.

About the role

You will be the key to what is in the pipeline, what is converting, what is slipping, and, most importantly, why, and the . Instrument the funnel and the systems that feed it

jobs.location: Denver, CO; Honolulu, HI; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
The goal of a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Scale is to own how we apply generative AI, agentic AI, computer vision, and reinforcement learning to mission-critical problems in production. Our senior machine learning engineers are handed problems that don't yet have an established approach, they propose the architecture, build it with support from other engineers, and are accountable for whether it holds up in the environments our customers depend on.

Our Public Sector Machine Learning team is focused on deploying cutting-edge models to mission-critical government systems through products like Donovan and Thunderforge. Our work spans multiple modalities, with our primary focus on agentic systems built on large language models. We are developing agents that solve complex operational and planning challenges for government partners: agent frameworks that integrate custom retrieval pipelines and production APIs, memory and context-management systems that hold state across long-running tasks, geospatial reasoning over maps and spatial data, and the evaluation tooling that benchmarks and refines agent behavior. We also apply reinforcement learning in targeted places where it earns its keep, and our computer vision work advances evaluation, labeling efficiency, and multimodal model training in support of defense applications.

As a Senior MLE, you'll have design authority over a capability area - the final say on the patterns used within your team, and the responsibility to make those patterns work under real constraints: classified environments, limited compute, and correctness requirements that don't bend.

You will:

  • Own the design and delivery of agent capabilities end to end - architecture, implementation, and the evaluation that proves they work
  • Define net-new patterns in problem spaces with no established approach, propose them to the wider team, and lead the work to build them
  • Take state of the art models developed internally and from the community and put them into production to solve problems for our customers and taskers
  • Improve and maintain production models and agents through retraining, hyperparameter tuning, and architectural updates, while preserving core performance characteristics
  • Build agent-level evaluation benchmarks, LLM judges, and verifiers - and use it to hillclimb performance rather than just report on it
  • Partner with product and research teams to scope and shape high-impact initiatives, including for upcoming product lines
  • Build scalable machine learning infrastructure to automate and optimize our ML services
  • Work directly with government users and subject-matter experts, and translate what you learn into technical direction
  • Act as a force multiplier and a prima

jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
About Scale AI

Scale AI accelerates the development and deployment of AI, from the high-quality training data and evaluation services that power the world's leading AI labs, to full-stack AI applications built for Enterprise, U.S. Public Sector, and Global Public Sector customers. We don't just hand over a model; we find the highest-value use case, build the system around it, and own the outcome, whether that's an agent supporting mission planning for the Department of Defense, a sovereign AI platform for a government ministry, or an agentic workflow inside a Fortune 500 enterprise. Our platform powers breakthroughs at the frontier of AI, and great design is how we make that power accessible, intuitive, and trusted by the teams who rely on it every day.

The Role

We're looking for a product design leader to lead and grow our enterprise team.

What You'll Do

  • Set the direction for Enterprise design. Define what exceptional design looks like for Scale's Applications customers making high-stakes decisions and for the expert contributors powering the platform. Translate the broader design vision into a clear, motivating direction for your team.
  • Build and lead the team. Own hiring, development, and day-to-day leadership for a growing team of designers. Create the culture and operating rhythms that let them do their best work.
  • Drive design execution across the Enterprise product. Partner with your Product and Engineering counterparts to set priorities and ensure design is involved from problem scoping through delivery, not brought in at the end.

Help define the interaction patterns for how enterprise users work alongside AI agents, and contribute to Scale's growing point of view on this emerging space.

Who you are

  • 3+ years managing product design teams
  • Proven track record of simplifying data-dense, power-user workflows into eleg

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Orchestration Platform

jobs.description:

The Orchestration Platform is a core technology used across the company to run durable, reliable, and scalable workflows. It powers the complex, long-running processes behind Scale’s products - from data and model-evaluation pipelines to operational systems and customer-facing workflows.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience of services that run critical company workflows.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, RL Environments
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
About Scale AI

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact.

Scale Frontier Data is the organization behind the training and evaluation data that frontier labs depend on. We build the systems, tooling, and expert workflows that turn hard human expertise into signals that models can learn from, across reasoning, coding, agentic tool use, and domain expertise.

Reinforcement learning environments are now the center of gravity for that work: the difference between a model that demos well and a model that reliably completes long-horizon work is almost always the quality of the environments and reward signals it was trained against.

Responsibilities

As a Staff Software Engineer, RL Environments, you'll own the technical foundation for how Scale builds, runs, verifies, and delivers RL environments at scale.

An RL environment is a real piece of software: a containerized world with real dependencies, real state, real tools, and a grader that has to be correct even when the agent is creative about breaking it. Building one is a full-stack engineering problem. Building thousands of them reproducibly, cheaply, with trustworthy reward signals and throughput measured in millions of rollouts is a systems problem that very few people have solved.

You'll work on both. You'll design the platform: sandboxed execution, environment packaging and versioning, rollout orchestration, trajectory capture, verifier frameworks, and the authoring surfaces that let engineers and domain experts produce environments without reinventing infrastructure each time. And you'll go deep on the environments themselves by instrumenting real applications, designing task suites that expose specific capability gaps, and building graders that hold up under adversarial optimization.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll set technical direction across multiple teams, and you'll still be the person who writes the hard part.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals in distributed systems, system design, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Strong Python skills and a track record of shipping production software; comfort in at least one other part of the stack (TypeScript/React, Go, Rust, or similar).
  • Deep experience with containerization and sandboxed execution, including Docker, VMs, gVisor/Firecracker, Kubernetes, or equivalent.
  • Experience building or operating high-throughput backend systems: orchestration, job scheduling, queuing, and large-scale data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs including agent loops, tool calling, MCP,

Scopely is seeking a Senior Level Designer to join our Stumble Guys team!

Stumble Guys is one of our most recent hits, with millions of fans joining the party every day and keeping the game at the top of the charts in more than 50 countries. Our ambition is to build a beloved franchise that players enjoy for many years to come.
This is a key role within the Gameplay team. As a Senior Level Designer, you will help shape the moment-to-moment player experience by designing levels, objectives, rules, and gameplay systems that are fun, readable, scalable, and replayable. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to create experiences that are accessible to new players while offering depth and mastery for returning players around the world.

What You Will Do

  • Design and iterate on levels, courses, arenas, objectives, and interactive gameplay spaces across a range of game modes.
  • Develop new win conditions, objectives, and progression structures that create varied and engaging multiplayer experiences.
  • Design and adapt gameplay rules to support different player capabilities, interaction styles, and gameplay strategies.

  • Write clear design documentation, including level-design briefs, gameplay rules, feature specifications, implementation guidelines, and iteration notes.
  • Prototype, block out, and iterate on levels and gameplay systems using appropriate in-game tools and workflows.

  • Use playtests, player feedback, telemetry, and live data to identify opportunities and improve level flow, pacing, difficulty, clarity, and engagement.

  • Partner with other designers to ensure that new gameplay systems integrate effectively across levels, modes, and player experiences.

  • Significant professional experience in level design, gameplay design, or a related discipline, ideally in multiplayer or live-service games.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating shipped levels, game modes, objectives, or multiplayer gameplay experiences.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

The Integrity and Attestation team's remit is to prove what is running at Anthropic: what code it is, where it came from, and whether the machine underneath it is in a known-good state. We build the systems that cryptographically verify build artifacts, model weights, and machines, from hardware roots of trust through firmware and boot to the credentials a workload receives. We also secure the management plane of our servers. These controls protect our model weights and customer data across cloud providers and bare-metal AI data centers, including sites operated by partners.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead this team. Anthropic is bringing up new compute quickly, across new hardware platforms and new partners, and each one has to meet the same bar. In this role you will set the team's charter, practices, and priorities. You will partner with our infrastructure, data center, and hardware teams, as well as outside vendors, so that integrity is designed in rather than added later. The goal is simple to state: a machine gets secrets and workloads only after it proves it should, and a new site reaches that bar without slowing down compute.

About the role

  • Own the integrity roadmap: threat model from silicon and firmware up through the operating system and workloads, decide what to build, and deliver it
  • Be able to reason about the design and implementation of remote attestation, measured and verified boot, hardware roots of trust (TPM, SPDM), machine identity, and the reference values that define known-good
  • Make attestation the default path, so machines receive credentials and join clusters only after proving their firmware, system software, and security configuration, with no human in the loop
  • Build provenance for what we deploy: signed build artifacts and model weights, independent verification, and tamper-evident transparency logs
  • Lead the protection of sensitive data in use and at rest, including encryption and the chokepoints that control access to it
  • Secure the server management plane across every site: scoped and audited access to baseboard management contr

En tant que responsable de deuxième niveau de l’équipe Applied AI Industries pour l’Europe du Sud et le Moyen-Orient chez Anthropic, vous stimulerez l’adoption de l’IA de pointe en partenariat avec le reste de l’organisation commerciale (go-to-market). Nos clients Industries en France, dans la péninsule Ibérique et en Italie comptent parmi les plus grandes entreprises de la région, dans les services financiers, la santé et les sciences de la vie, l’industrie manufacturière, les télécommunications, la distribution, l’énergie et d’autres secteurs. Vous vous appuierez sur votre expérience de la création et du management d’équipes d’avant-vente technique pour favoriser une transformation positive par l’IA, qui réponde aux besoins métier de nos clients et à leurs exigences techniques et réglementaires, tout en offrant un haut niveau de fiabilité et de sécurité.

Vous dirigerez et développerez l’équipe d’architectes de solutions qui travaille avec les account executives pour aider les entreprises à adopter et à déployer les produits d’Anthropic, notamment Claude Cowork, Claude Code et la Claude Development Platform (notre API). Vous mettrez à profit vos compétences techniques et votre expérience de la vente consultative pour recruter d’excellents managers de premier niveau et contributeurs individuels, mettre en place les processus nécessaires au passage à l’échelle de votre équipe et représenter directement Anthropic lors d’échanges stratégiques avec les clients. jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

At Twitch, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) partners with key stakeholders across the business to guide financial decisions and deliver actionable insights that shape the company’s growth. We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to join our team, reporting to the Director of FP&A. In this role, you will act as a bridge between FP&A and emerging artificial intelligence tools, shifting from manual number-crunching to automated, agentic finance workflows and strategic data insights.

  • AI & Workflow Automation: Partner with tech teams to implement AI agents, agentic workflows, and automated data pipelines to streamline budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and reconciliations
  • FP&A Modernization: Leverage AI tools to move away from manual data extraction and report formatting to focus on real-time driver-based forecasting, KPI metrics, and strategic advisory
  • Technology & ROI Business Analysis: Build financial models

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Applications are now open for our January cohort - apply here by October 30.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on an empirical project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Access to a shared workspace (in either Bay Area, California, Toronto, Canada, or London, UK)
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community
  • Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application & reference check, technical assessments & interviews, and a research discussion.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

What is the need and role

Anthropic's mission depends on compute, and compute depends on power. Today, energy is increasingly the binding constraint on how fast frontier AI infrastructure comes online. The energy team sources, structures, and contracts that power, and its work touches nearly every part of the company and a growing set of people outside it.

We're looking for someone to join the energy team in a special projects role: to take on the problems that don't sit inside any one deal or region, and to carry them wherever they lead. That means working in three circles. Inside Compute, with the teams that site, design, build, finance, and operate our data centers. Across Anthropic, with policy, legal, communications, finance, and the other teams that need energy depth or whose work shapes ours. And outside the company, with FERC, state commissions and agencies, RTOs and ISOs, utilities, industry working groups, and other large energy customers.

It's a "figure it out / get it done" role for someone who can chase down issues while bringing real depth in energy: the kind of person who can untangle a power delivery problem with design and delivery in the morning, brief the policy team on what a FERC proceeding means for our sites in the afternoon, speak for us on a working group call the next day, and then pick up an unrelated problem the energy team needs solved that week. Much of the job is building coalitions among complex, multi-functional groups of stakeholders, and then running the project all the way to completion.

What you'll do

1/ Inside Compute

  • Working with the head of energy, pick up cross-functional problems as they arise that have no natural owner, work them with the teams involved to a decision, process, or tool, then hand them off and move on to the next one.

  • Connect the energy commercial leads with site selection, data center design, delivery, operations, and finance, so that everyone plans on the same assumptions about power: when it arrives, how much, how reliable, and at what cost.

  • Write the strategy documents, decision memos, and leadership updates that explain the energy team's choices to executives who do not work in energy.

  • Build the processes and tools, with Claude, that keep the team's commitments, open decisions, and stakeholder record current, so none of it depends on one person's memory.

About the role

Anthropic's go-to-market teams are scaling quickly, and the decisions they make, from who to sell to and how to cover them to where to invest next, are only as good as the intelligence and infrastructure underneath them. As a Data Engineer on the GTM Systems data foundations team, you'll help build that layer: the data products that give sellers, operators, and analysts a rich, current, and trusted picture of the market, and the engineering rigor that lets our GTM systems run reliably as the business grows.

This is an engineering role that goes beyond pipelines. You'll treat GTM data as a product and a platform: built once, kept current, and available wherever people work. Alongside the build, you'll help shape what the data means: how attributes are defined, which sources are trusted, and how the business puts them to use. The role sits at the intersection of the sales organization, the data organization, and the systems that data flows through. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy and Operations, Finance, Data Science, and the central data engineering team.

Key responsibilities

  • Bring disparate internal and external sources together: orchestrate, model, and normalize first-party product and revenue data alongside third-party data into one usable understanding of the company landscape

  • Build and maintain identity and entity resolution, so every source attaches to one trusted record for each company and the relationships between companies are clear

  • Help build the canonical layer where key attributes are defined once and mean the same thing everywhere, with clear sourcing logic, provenance, and freshness

  • Turn data into intelligence: scores, signals, and AI-generated attributes that help GTM teams prioritize and act, held to the same quality bar as any other source

  • Deliver that intelligence to the surfaces where teams work, including the CRM, and bring production discipline to how data moves through those systems

  • Operate what you build as a living system, with observability, data quality, cost, security, and access controls designed in, so problems surface before the field sees them

  • Partner with the owners of GTM processes such as planning, segmentation, and routing to settle definitions, make clear commitments, and communicate tradeoffs

  • Make the platform easy for other teams to build on, so work is contributed once and not rebuilt in silos

jobs.title: Senior Language Programmer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking an experienced Senior Language Programmer to join our Verse team, which owns the toolchain (compiler, VM, and runtime) that powers game development in Unreal Engine and UEFN. You'll work on the systems every UE and UEFN developer relies on to build and ship games with Verse.

In this role, you will

  • Extend, evolve, and maintain the Verse compiler toolchain, transactional memory runtime and VM, add new platform support, implement new language features and integrate with Unreal Engine's content, build, and cooking pipelines
  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and iteration times across the Verse toolchain, runtime and UE/Verse boundary
  • Work closely with language consumers to ensure an exceptional user experience
  • Establish test workflows to validate improvements and prevent regressions
  • Design and maintain the scripting interface to Unreal Engine, working in close collaboration with the Verse Language team and the broader UE engineering organization

What we're looking for

  • Expert knowledge of C++17 or later
  • Experience in compiler or toolchain development (e.g., compiler internals, VM design, Clang/LLVM, or linker/platform ABI specifics)
  • Experience developing and optimizing large codebases, with the ability to make tradeoffs between usability, performance, and power
  • Strong ability to reason about large, interconnected systems
  • Solid grounding in software engineering principles, including API design
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver practical solutions
  • Experience with Unreal Engine integration is a plus

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

  • Proactive, independent and reliable, with the ability to deliver under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach

This role is open to multiple locations in Europe.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Platform Intelligence turns each new Claude model's abilities into API features that developers can build on. Our goal is to make the full intelligence of each model available through the API. We own the capabilities that shape what Claude can do for developers: tool use, built-in tools such as web search and code execution, thinking controls, structured outputs, and the memory, files, and skills APIs.

We also run the API side of every Claude model launch, including its safety features and controls. That means getting the API ready for each new model, coordinating with research, safeguards, product, and cloud partners, and making sure the model, its features, the SDKs, and the docs all ship together on launch day.

jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re looking for a Brand Designer to join the Figma Brand Studio and focus on designing for the web. This role will help up-level some of our most important surfaces—our marketing websites—in brand-forward, novel, and unexpected ways.

  • Share learnings, experiments, and techniques with Brand Studio and partners to raise the bar across the org

jobs.title: Senior Cyber Defense Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

Epic's Security Operations Center protects one of the world's largest player communities, along with the people, infrastructure, and technology that support it. As a Senior CDO Analyst, you will lead investigations and incident response while helping reinvent how the SOC operates, turning repeatable analysis into automated, Al-assisted workflows so the team can focus on the threats that matter most.

In this role, you will

  • Lead the triage, investigation, and response for security alerts and incidents across cloud, corporate, endpoint, identity, and production environments
  • Act as an escalation point and incident lead, coordinating with programming, legal, privacy, and business partners through containment, remediation, and post-incident review
  • Drive the detection lifecycle management, developing, tuning, and retiring detection logic to maximize signal-to-noise ratio, minimize alert fatigue, and close emerging threat gaps
  • Identify recurring analyst work and partner with security programming to automate it, including Al-agent workflows with clear validation and human review where it counts
  • Turn threat intelligence and emerging vulnerabilities into rapid exposure assessments and actionable response across the company
  • Develop and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and operational metrics that make the SOC faster, more consistent, and easier to scale
  • Set and elevate standards for investigation quality and case documentation, actively coaching analysts and holding managed-service partners accountable to rigorous SLAs and analytical depth

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or threat detection, including leading investigations end-to-end
  • Deep hands-on experience with SIEM and EDR platforms (e.g., Splunk, Google SecOps, Crow

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for a Contracts Manager to support our commercial and technology transactions. You'll partner with our GTM teams on enterprise customer deals, including some of our largest and most complex agreements. You'll review, draft, and negotiate commercial and procurement contracts that support our AI systems, and build the contracting processes that help us scale. You’ll collaborate with Product, Sales, Finance, Business Operations, Research, and Procurement.

We're a relatively small legal team supporting big things, so everyone works across multiple areas. We'd love to hear where else you'd be interested in pitching in, whether because of your experience or your interests.

Key responsibilities

  • Draft, analyze, negotiate, and close complex commercial and procurement transactions with enterprise customers, vendors, and strategic partners, including IP licensing agreements
  • Propose and build scalable solutions that improve contracting efficiency
  • Work with business units and legal team members to streamline contract management, identify potential risks, and drive continuous improvement
  • Partner with Sales on customer calls and live negotiations, working directly with customers' legal and procurement teams to resolve open issues and close deals
  • Manage your deals from first redline through signature, including next steps, follow-ups, and cross-functional coordination
  • Turn what you learn on deals into better templates, playbooks, and guidance for Legal and Sales

Minimum qualifications

  • Have substantial experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts in support of technology transactions, sales organizations, or partnerships
  • Are a self-starter who spots what needs doing, takes ownership, and manages complex contractual matters and competing deadlines autonomously
  • Perform well in an environment that moves quickly, with shifting priorities, incomplete information, and new types of deals and contract issues

jobs.title: Senior Identity Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Identity Security Engineer to join our Information Security team on a remote basis or hybrid basis if located in Barcelona. This is a hands-on engineer who will build identity controls that reduce excessive privilege and protect critical operations. You will improve access across employee, player, business partner, and non-human identities by building AI-native identity workflows: agentic systems that handle provisioning, access reviews, and remediation within explicit guardrails, with humans approving what matters. Your work will protect the identities and access that support Scopely’s critical business processes, including essential enterprise functions and game operations. This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who can operate across AWS, GCP, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Zero Trust access models, identity governance workflows, and modern AI-enabled engineering environments, while building scalable identity systems through Infrastructure as Code, workflow orchestration, and automation-first security engineering.

What You Will Do

Reduce identity attack surface and privilege

  • Reduce standing and excessive access with least-privilege roles, just-in-time and time-bound elevation, and automated access reviews.
  • Build repeatable identity and access workflows that make onboarding, approvals, role changes, reviews, and offboarding consistent, traceable, and timely.
  • Govern non-human identities, including service accounts, workload identities, CI/CD identities, API credentials, and AI agents and their tool integrations: inventory them, assign owners, replace long-lived secrets with short-lived or federated credentials, and rotate or revoke on a schedule and on signal.

Strengthen identity protection and resilience

  • Protect access to critical business processes and systems with phishing-resistant authentication (passkeys/FIDO2), device trust and posture signals, tightly controlled privileged access, and prompt revocation of suspicious sessions or compromised credentials.
  • Threat-model identity platforms, integrations, and access paths to identify exploitable trust relationships, privilege escalation, and credential misuse.
  • Build identity telemetry and response workflows to detect risky sign-ins, privilege changes, credential misuse, and compromised integrations.
  • Design and test break-glass and recovery procedures for identity services and cloud access so teams can regain secure access during an outage or compromise.
  • Extend the same patterns to player and partner identities where security owns the controls: platform identity federation (Apple, Google, Steam, console), account linking and recovery, external and vendor access, and defenses against account takeover and credential stuffing.

Build A

Together AI runs one of the largest GPU fleets in the world. The Infra Agent Systems team builds the software systems that power and automate that infrastructure.

We develop production AI agents that diagnose hardware failures, investigate incidents, correlate signals across the fleet, and automate operational workflows. Alongside these agents, we build the platform they run on, including knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and developer tooling.
